verdict.rationale: Sift publishes a full API reference portal at developers.sift.com, covering the Events, Decisions, Score, Workflows and Webhooks APIs. Each page has a selectable language (curl, Python, Java) plus request/response examples, and a separate sandbox environment exists for sending test events. However, the evidence explicitly notes that no live try-it runner is documented, so the examples are copy-paste rather than runnable in place. missing for 10: in-page runnable/try-it console, interactive request execution against sandbox from the reference, independent corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: developers.sift.com is a full API reference portal (Events, Decisions, Score, Workflows, Webhooks APIs) with per-language implementations selectable per page (curl, Python, Java, and more) and request/response examples
The API reference is published per dated version (v205/v204/v203 selectable; versioned URL pattern /docs/v205/...)
